summary: Both tokens are literal I Infectum 1 skinning with human patients. The inherited example already has the human context, so this is not a newly discovered participant extension or separate sense.
The repeated Kosəlxi appe supplies an overt ʕal-pronominal affected target; the first token has no expressed object. Record this valency contrast without inventing a translation of the second clause.
The inherited gloss abhauten remains verbatim. No new stem, box, Detransitive use or idiom is supported.
Locate the edition's translation of the final Kosəlxi appe at 87/84, and confirm the precise affected-target function of appe before publishing it as an added example.
Correct the spelling of abhäuten in the sense gloss
rationale: The sense is skinning: the head gives abhäuten, enthäuten, and the example translation has Abhäuten. The infinitive in the sense gloss is missing the umlaut.
